items.name: starter-react
items.title: zod-to-form starter (runtime)
items.description: Schema-driven React Hook Form from a Zod schema, rendered at runtime with <ZodForm>. Zod + react-hook-form + shadcn/ui, with validation and codegen via zod-to-form.
items.docs:
This starter ships a sample Zod schema and a z2f config wired to shadcn components.

Next steps:
1. Re-generate the config for YOUR components and schemas:
   npx @zod-to-form/cli init
2. Design and iterate your schema visually in the playground:
   https://zod.toform.dev/play/
